hatch.label: A hatch in the floor, bolted from below

lines.fetch_ok: Alright. Alright. Let's get this over with.
lines.fetch_missing: It's gone. The box is gone. God help me.
lines.arrive: Miss Moreau. I brought it. Let's- where are we going?

news.missing: Abe Kessler's gone. Nobody's seen him since last night.
news.saw_vesper: Abe went into the Vesper after closing. Nobody saw him come out.
news.evidence: They found Abe's glasses in the Vesper.

abe: Mr. Kessler? He came by, we talked business, he left before two. Why do you ask?
I pour drinks. I don't keep track of old men.
Abe owes me four hundred bucks. You think I'd make him disappear before he pays? Use your head.

quest.title: THE MISSING MERCHANT
stages: letter_read
A letter on Abe Kessler's desk: 'C.' wants him to bring 'the item' to the Vesper tonight, after he closes, and to come inside.
book_read
Abe's appointment book: 'C.M. from the Vesper, about the box. Tonight, after I close.'
ledger_read
The Nite Owl's ledger: Abe owes Marv $400, three weeks late. He said something 'old' would square it.
box_taken
You have Abe's tin box. It is very heavy, and something inside it shifts on its own.
abe_gone_heard
Abe Kessler is missing. Nobody's seen him since he closed the shop.
witness_vesper
Someone saw Abe go into the Vesper after closing. Nobody saw him come out.
claudette_story
Claudette Moreau says Abe left the Vesper before two.
marv_alibi
Marv says he'd never make Abe disappear before he paid. Fair point.
spectacles_found
Abe's spectacles, cracked, on the floor of the Vesper's back room, beside a hatch bolted from below.
told_doyle
You showed Officer Doyle the spectacles. He's watching the Vesper now.
contradictions: Claudette says he left. Nobody saw him leave.
endings: Abe never went to the Vesper. He's alive, at home, with the door locked. Someone will come asking about that box.
Doyle has the spectacles and a reason. Whatever is under the Vesper, the police are watching the door now.
Abe went down through the hatch in the Vesper's back room. Whatever is under it, that's where he is. (Continues below the street.)
